raw_posts.name: Inbox Zero
raw_posts.description: Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.

raw_posts.name: MyLens
raw_posts.tagline: 1-1 Live Presentations at Scale with AI.
raw_posts.description: MyLens is AI for live 1-1 presentations at scale. You add your raw sources, say what matters, and invite your audience. MyLens AI gives every person a live, private presentation, answers their questions using your sources, and create new slides and layers in real time during the presentation. Then the AI tells you how each session went, so you can see who’s doing well, who’s stuck, and what to do next.

raw_posts.name: shim-cli
raw_posts.tagline: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can.
raw_posts.description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.

raw_posts.name: Tower 18 for Mac
raw_posts.tagline: The most powerful Git client with a better CLI experience
raw_posts.description: Tower 18 for Mac is here! This update is all about improving the Tower experience in the terminal: the Tower Command Line Tool can now take you straight to any view in Tower (History, Blame, the Working Copy, Branches Review, and more) with a single command.

raw_posts.name: MeetPaw
raw_posts.tagline: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar
raw_posts.description: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

raw_posts.name: XBOX Nano Controller
raw_posts.tagline: Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs
raw_posts.description: Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices.

raw_posts.name: 3AM Super Intelligence
raw_posts.description: Meet 3AM, the AI on-call engineer for systems you can’t rewrite. It finds the root cause, rehearses the fix, and resolves the incident with one tap in Slack, all from inside your network.

raw_posts.name: Tomo for ChatGPT
raw_posts.tagline: Ask anything. Then play it, Duolingo-style.
raw_posts.description: Ask ChatGPT for a Tomo course on black holes and a game drops into the chat. Quick questions, hearts on the line. Any topic, even the chat you’re in. Pick your teacher, from The Professor to The Pirate. Add Tomo from Plugins in ChatGPT. No sign-up to start.

raw_posts.name: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
raw_posts.tagline: Amazon's personal AI memory, now on your wrist or phone
raw_posts.description: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse are Amazon's new personal AI devices that help you remember what matters. Frontier is a wearable for your wrist or clothing, while Eclipse attaches magnetically to your phone. Both capture conversations and turn them into useful summaries, reminders, and follow-ups without retaining audio recordings. With Alexa+ integration, your personal AI memory can help you recall important details and act on them later.

raw_posts.name: Openbroca
raw_posts.tagline: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
raw_posts.description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.
